CONSTRAINTS.reason: C: drive at 3.3% free space - NTFS performance degrades severely below 15% free. Pagefile cannot safely expand on C:.

RECOMMENDATION.rationale: Move pagefile from C: (system SSD, 3.3% free) to F: (data SSD, 6.2% free, better small-file performance). Increase pagefile to 24 GB to raise commit limit from 59.5 GB to ~74 GB, providing headroom for UE4Editor + 4 SCW workers.
steps: Create fixed-size pagefile on F: (24576 MB initial/max)
RECOMMENDATION.risk: Requires reboot. Monitor F: free space after relocation.

ALTERNATIVE.rationale: Adding 32 GB RAM would raise commit limit to ~91 GB without pagefile dependency. Preferred long-term solution.
